description: Wire the React frontend's Phase-C placeholders to the FoodHerons.Api order service from FEAT-001: add a token-aware fetch helper, the Vite /api dev proxy, and replace the TODO placeholders in Cart.jsx (place order), OrderStatus.jsx (student cancel), and Dashboard.jsx (vendor accept/ready/complete/reject). All order writes go through the C# service; status reads stay direct-to-Supabase. Depends on FEAT-001's HTTP contract (routes, request/response shapes, error codes). The frontend still builds independently via `npm run build` (no live backend needed to build).
steps: Add src/lib/api.js: a fetch helper that reads the access token via supabase.auth.getSession() (data.session.access_token), sets Authorization: Bearer <token> and Content-Type: application/json, uses base import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api', and on non-2xx parses the JSON body and throws a typed error exposing { status, code, ... } so callers can branch on ITEM_UNAVAILABLE / VENDOR_CLOSED / ILLEGAL_TRANSITION. Provide helpers like postOrder(body) -> POST /orders and transitionOrder(id, body) -> POST /orders/{id}/transition.

Add the Vite dev proxy in vite.config.js WITHOUT disturbing the existing server.port (5173) / open: inside the existing server block add proxy: { '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:5080', changeOrigin: true } }.

Wire src/pages/Cart.jsx placeOrder: POST /api/orders via the helper with body { vendorId, pickupName, note, items: lines.map(l => ({ menuItemId: l.item.id, qty: l.qty })) } (ids + qty ONLY, never prices). On 201 success: clearCart() then navigate('/order/' + resp.id) (the returned UUID). Map error codes to friendly inline messages (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE -> an item is unavailable; VENDOR_CLOSED -> vendor not accepting orders). Remove the 'coming soon' placeholder

and the unconditional disabled on the submit button; keep disabled only while submitting or when `closed`. Add submitting state + inline error display.

Wire src/pages/OrderStatus.jsx: replace the disabled pending-state Cancel button TODO with a handler that prompts for a cancel reason then calls transitionOrder(order.uuid, { to: 'cancelled', reason }); on success re-run the existing Supabase order fetch (refresh the order). Use order.uuid (the real UUID already captured in state), NOT order.id (= display code). Keep reading status via Supabase. Surface ILLEGAL_TRANSITION (lost race) as a friendly message.

Wire src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: FIRST fix the UUID gap — add id to the orders .select('id, code, pickup_name, status, total, placed_at, cancel_reason, order_items(name, qty)') and carry it onto each order object as uuid: o.id (both the live and done branches); ensure OrdersTab / onStatus / onReject pass the UUID, not o.code. Then replace changeStatus(uuid, to) and reject(uuid, reason) with transitionOrder(uuid, { to }) / transitionOrder(uuid, { to:'cancelled', reason }) calls (accept->preparing, mark ready->ready, handed over->completed, reject->cancelled+reason), and after success re-run the Supabase orders fetch instead of the optimistic-only state mutation. Keep a toast on success and surface errors.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` succeeds after all wiring (frontend has no test runner).
Cart.jsx sends only { vendorId, pickupName, note, items:[{menuItemId, qty}] } (no prices) and navigates to /order/<returned uuid> on success.
OrderStatus.jsx student cancel calls POST /api/orders/{uuid}/transition { to:'cancelled', reason } and refreshes via Supabase; status is still read via Supabase.

Dashboard.jsx accept/ready/complete/reject call POST /api/orders/{uuid}/transition with the correct `to` (and reason for reject) using the order UUID (not the display code), and refresh via Supabase after.
vite.config.js proxies /api -> http://localhost:5080 with changeOrigin:true and still sets port 5173 / open.
No client-side direct write to orders/order_items is introduced (order writes go only through the service); grep of src/ shows no orders/order_items .insert or .update.
verification: Run `npm run build` from the worktree root and confirm it succeeds.
Grep src/ for direct Supabase writes to orders/order_items (`from('orders')` followed by .insert/.update, same for order_items) and confirm none were added — only reads remain.
Confirm vite.config.js contains the /api proxy to localhost:5080 and that Cart/OrderStatus/Dashboard no longer contain the Phase-C TODO placeholders / disabled buttons.
findings:
FEAT-002 complete. `npm run build` succeeds from the worktree root (vite build, 119 modules, exit 0). All order WRITES now go through the C# service; status READS stay direct-to-Supabase. No new orders/order_items .insert/.update introduced (grep of worktree src/ shows only .select reads on orders/order_items; the only .insert is reviews, the only .update calls target vendors/menu_items/profiles). No Phase-C order TODO placeholders / unconditionally-disabled order buttons remain in Cart/OrderStatus/Dashboard. === WHAT WAS WIRED === src/lib/api.js (NEW): token-aware fetch helper. Reads access token via supabase.auth.getSession() -> data.session.access_token, sets Authorization: Bearer + Content-Type: application/json, base = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api'. On non-2xx it parses the ProblemDetails JSON and throws ApiError (exposes { status, code, ...extras } e.g. field/menuItemId/from/to/correlationId). Exports postOrder(body) -> POST /orders and transitionOrder(id, body) -> POST /orders/{id}/transition. vite.config.js: added server.proxy { '/api': { target: 'http://localhost:5080', changeOrigin: true } } INSIDE the existing server block; port 5173 + open:true preserved. src/pages/Cart.jsx: placeOrder now async -> postOrder({ vendorId, pickupName: trimmed, note: trimmed||null, items: lines.map(l => ({ menuItemId: l.item.id, qty: l.qty })) }) (ids+qty ONLY, no prices). On success: clearCart() then navigate('/order/' + resp.id) (returned UUID). Added submitting + error state; error codes mapped to friendly inline messages (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE, VENDOR_CLOSED, VALIDATION). Removed the 'coming soon'

and the unconditional disabled; submit button now disabled only while submitting or when closed. src/pages/OrderStatus.jsx: Supabase order fetch refactored into a reusable fetchOrder() useCallback (still direct-to-Supabase, same select incl. unit_price). Pending-state Cancel button is live: cancelOrder() window.prompt's for a reason, calls transitionOrder(order.uuid, { to:'cancelled', reason }), then refreshes via fetchOrder(). Uses order.uuid (real UUID), NOT order.id (display code). ILLEGAL_TRANSITION surfaced as a friendly 'vendor already started' message; cancelling/cancelError state added. src/pages/Dashboard.jsx: FIXED the UUID gap — orders .select now includes id (was already selecting it in this file's version; confirmed) and each order object carries uuid: o.id plus id: o.code (display) on BOTH the live and done branches. The Supabase fetch was refactored into a loadOrders() useCallback so transitions can refresh. changeStatus(uuid, to) and reject(uuid, reason) now call transitionOrder(uuid, { to }) / transitionOrder(uuid, { to:'cancelled', reason }) and await loadOrders() after success (replacing the optimistic-only state mutation). OrdersTab action button passes o.uuid to onStatus; RejectDialog passes order.uuid to onConfirm. Success toasts kept (Order accepted / ready / handed over / rejected); errors shown via flash, with a refresh on ILLEGAL_TRANSITION lost races. === CONTRACT NOTES FOR INTEGRATION/REVIEW === - Dev run requires the C# service on http://localhost:5080 (the Vite proxy forwards /api there) AND valid VITE_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY in .env.local so the session token exists. - transitionOrder `to` values used: accept->'preparing', mark ready->'ready', handed over->'completed', reject/student-cancel->'cancelled' (+reason). These match the backend legal set from FEAT-001. - OrderStatus still maps DB 'preparing' -> 'Accepted' UI step (unchanged DB_STATUS_TO_STEP). - Only vite.config.js + src/ were changed; no backend, SQL, or .env files touched.
